conf.description: VMware NSX Distributed Firewall dfw-packet-log / syslog-raw: no Elastic integration and no installed Cribl Pack exist, so this hand-built pipeline owns the positional dfwpktlogs grammar natively, branching on the match/TERM token per recommendations.direct.cribl.

conf.comment: vmware-nsx/dfw-packet-log/syslog-raw. Catalog mechanism is cribl-pack (community NSX syslog pack), but no Packs are installed on this instance, so the pack's field naming/ECS coverage is built natively here per the brief. Discriminates dfwpktlogs-ident lines out of the merged ESXi syslog stream, branches match vs TERM (disjoint column sets), resolves direction/protocol/type vocab to ECS, and leaves the per-vNIC IN/OUT-to-source/destination byte/packet split unresolved (documented gap - see README).

functions.description: record scope, pack substitution, and the one known gap up front

split the common dfwpktlogs prefix (timestamp, host, VIF id, address family, match/TERM discriminator) from the reason-specific tail; assumed space-delimited grammar per the work order's documented field order - no literal raw sample was supplied, so verify against a live feed before production use
discard non-dfwpktlogs lines (hostd/vmkernel/vobd etc.) that share the same ESXi syslog stream - this pipeline owns only the DFW packet log ident
match-record tail: action, rule set/id, direction, packet size, protocol, src/dst ip:port, TCP flags
TERM-record tail: rule set/id, direction, protocol, src/dst ip:port, close reason, in/out packet and byte pairs - no action column on this shape

compute every derived/normalized field from the ORIGINAL vendor names before the batched rename below (ORDER MATTERS rule) - vocab translation, action/outcome/type derivation, session totals, custom vmware.nsx.dfw.* fields
batch every clean-named mapped/partial field into its ECS target in one rename
set Cribl's canonical _time from the record's own ISO 8601 timestamp - never target @timestamp directly (constraint 1)
coerce remaining numeric-looking string fields (rule.id, source.port, destination.port) to numbers
drop now-redundant working fields (including _raw, per the direct recommendation to drop it once the parser is proven) and tag the event
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
